VIKI Agent / Guide

10 min read · 5 sections

Slack and Discord messaging

The optional Slack and Discord bridges let one configured owner send text and answer current requests in a private direct message. Each uses a separate conversation, pinned to the workspace selected when VIKI Agent launched. Desktop chats and the other providers remain separate.

  • auto mode
    each conversation uses Claude Code's auto permission mode. Claude Code's classifier reviews its actions, and a request it still makes arrives as a permission card.
  • Manual mode
    where auto mode is unavailable, Claude Code starts the conversation in Manual mode, and every action arrives as a card.

Set up and turn on each bridge from Messaging. Saved settings apply without restart.

  1. Select Set up on its card, or select the provider's name to open the card.
  2. Fill in its fields.
  3. Select Save changes.
  4. Turn the bot on with the switch beside its status.

A bot you leave on reconnects on its own the next time VIKI Agent starts in the workspace you turned it on in. In any other workspace it stays off until you turn it on there. Mattermost setup is in Mattermost mobile access.

Cards start closed. An open card also shows whether anything is saved: Needs setup, Saved settings, or Settings unreadable. The status, the switch and any stop reason, error or cooldown stay visible while a card is closed.

StatusWhat to do
Not configuredSelect Set up, fill in the fields and select Save changes.
DisabledTurn the bot on with the switch when you want to connect.
ConnectingWait for authentication and the bot's ready message.
ConnectedSend fresh text in the configured owner's DM.
StoppedFollow the card's reason: fix what it names, then turn the bot on again after cleanup and any displayed cooldown.
The card says "Restart VIKI Agent to use this bot again with the current workspace."Restart VIKI Agent. This happens when the startup workspace changed or the bridge could not shut down cleanly. Until then its switch stays visible but does nothing.
  • Refresh status
    reads state without connecting.
  • Turning a bot off
    stops that bridge, invalidates its current requests and closes its dedicated conversation. You can turn it on again in the same launch.
  • Tokens and other providers
    these controls do not revoke provider tokens or stop another provider.
  • New connections
    each new connection waits for fresh messages. It does not pick up offline messages or retry a previous turn.

A stopped card says why. For example:

  • Slack rejected the bot or app token, or Discord rejected the bot token.
  • The service could not be reached. A network refusal during Slack's Socket Mode setup or Discord's Gateway lookup appears as an unreachable service.
  • The account check failed.
  • The bot reached a safety limit.
  • Its conversation reported an error or was closed.
  • A request changed or could not be shown completely.
  • An unexpected error occurred.
  • The connection ended after it was connected.

A bot that had posted its ready message also posts one line saying why in the direct message, best effort within 3 seconds. The reason stays until you turn the bot on again or save or remove the settings. While a card is connecting or connected, it updates on its own.

01Before connecting

Keep the desktop host awake and VIKI Agent running:

  • Windows and Linux
    keep an app window open.
  • macOS
    in a browser window, keep that browser running; in VIKI Agent's own window, keep a window open.

A code startup workspace must be persistent and ordinary. Selecting another workspace in the app does not move a bridge: it keeps working in the workspace VIKI Agent started with. VIKI Agent checks that workspace again before the bridge starts a conversation.

Important

Prompts, final replies, complete operation requests and, after you send !viki questions on, questions from your other desktop chats leave this computer through a bridge. Slack or Discord and signed-in clients can retain them under their own policies. Local Reset and exports do not erase remote copies.

Service operators and anyone controlling the configured owner account are part of this trust boundary. Use an account you control, enable MFA, and review the service's retention policy.

How tokens and network access are handled:

  • Tokens
    bot and app tokens are sealed in the local app database and are never shown again, only a placeholder.
  • Status and settings card
    Messaging status contains no tokens, account IDs, server URLs or message text. The settings card can show the saved non-secret values (such as a member or user ID), but never a token.
  • Network
    the local listener stays on loopback; these bridges make outbound HTTPS and WSS connections. Do not expose the local port to reach the bot.

02Slack setup

Use an internal Slack app in the configured owner's workspace. The owner and bot must belong to the same workspace, with a private two-person DM; shared and multi-person conversations are refused.

In Slack:

  1. Follow Slack's Socket Mode setup to create the app, enable Socket Mode and generate an app-level token.
  2. Give the bot these scopes: users:read, im:write, im:read, im:history and chat:write.
  3. Subscribe only to the bot event message.im.
  4. Install or reinstall the app in that workspace to apply its permissions.
  5. Give the app-level token connections:write.

In the Slack card in Messaging:

  1. Use the installed bot's xoxb- token for Bot token.
  2. Use the app-level token for App token.
  3. Copy the active human owner's member ID, not the bot ID, display name or email, into Your member ID. Slack's member ID instructions describe More → Copy member ID in a profile.
  4. Select Save changes. Save refuses a Bot token that does not start with xoxb- or an App token that does not start with xapp-, and says which.
  5. Turn the Slack bot on.
  6. Wait for the ready message in the owner's DM with the bot.

Send new top-level text there.

  • Refused
    Slack thread replies, edited messages, files and attachments.
  • Replies
    replies from VIKI Agent stay top-level and use Slack mrkdwn for readable paragraphs, headings, emphasis and code.
  • Links
    URL-like text is kept inert; Slack link and media unfurls are disabled.
  • New connection requests
    Socket Mode periodically requests a new connection. VIKI Agent stops the Slack bridge then; turn the Slack bot on again manually.
  • Posting pace
    posting is paced at one new post per second. A rate-limit response stops the bridge until its cooldown expires.
  • Message history
    the bridge uses conversations.history only to confirm the one live message it received.
  • App distribution
    Slack's limits depend on app distribution. This setup is for an internal app, not a commercially distributed Marketplace integration.

03Discord setup

Set up a Discord application with a bot, then connect it from the Discord card in Messaging. This bridge does not provide slash commands or an interaction endpoint.

  1. Create an application with a bot using Discord's application and bot setup.
  2. Arrange a DM between that bot and the configured human owner. Installation and DM availability depend on Discord's app and account settings.
  3. In the Discord card's Bot token field, use the bot token from the application's Bot page. Do not use a human account token, OAuth access token, application public key or webhook token.
  4. Copy the human owner's numeric user ID into Your user ID, using Discord's Developer Mode ID tools. Use a different non-bot account from the authenticated bot.
  5. Fill in Client URL. It must be a public HTTPS app or support page without embedded credentials, whitespace or control characters.
  6. Select Save changes.
  7. Turn the Discord bot on, and wait for the bot's ready DM.

The Client URL is included only in the required HTTP header, DiscordBot (<client-url>, <installed-version>); VIKI Agent does not fetch it. See Discord's User-Agent requirements.

Send plain new top-level text.

  • Refused
    guild messages, group DMs, webhooks and self-bot authentication. Edited messages, references/replies, forwarded messages, files, embeds, components and polls are refused too.
  • Replies
    replies are top-level posts with readable paragraphs, lists, emphasis and code.
  • Inert text and size
    URL-like text stays inert, mentions are suppressed, and posts are capped at 2000 UTF-16 units each.
  • Connection
    the connection uses Discord REST and Gateway v10 with DIRECT_MESSAGES intent only.
  • Stops
    missing heartbeat acknowledgment, reconnect/invalid-session requests or socket loss stop the bridge. Turn the Discord bot on again manually after cleanup and any displayed cooldown.
  • Discord's limits
    Discord's REST pacing, session-start quota and five-second Identify window remain in force when you disable and reconnect. There is no automatic Resume or reconnect within a launch.

04Text and current approvals

Ordinary text starts the dedicated conversation. The bot posts the final reply of every turn of its conversation while it is active, including a turn Claude Code starts by itself, such as a background agent's report.

  • While Claude is working
    a message you send is added to the running turn, and the bot replies "Added to the running turn."
  • Conversation busy
    if the turn ends first, or after !viki stop or !viki new until the stopped turn has ended, the bot replies that the conversation is busy. Send the message again after the turn ends.
  • Bridge commands
    !viki help, !viki status, !viki new and !viki stop affect this bridge's conversation. While a turn runs, !viki status shows its status line; otherwise it says the conversation is ready or busy.
  • Refused
    Claude Code's slash commands and other ! commands.
  • Mode, model and workspace
    Messaging does not change the conversation's mode, model or workspace.

Answer a request

Current permission requests offer Allow once and Deny through !viki allow <nonce> and !viki deny <nonce>. A fully displayed question lists its questions with numbered options.

  • Pick
    when a fully displayed question's instructions include a Pick line, it accepts a pick through !viki pick <nonce> <picks>: one option number per question, in order, with numbers joined by commas where a question allows more than one, like 1,3.
  • Your own words
    a fully displayed question also accepts free-text Other through !viki answer <nonce> <free-text>, which sends your own words as your reply instead of a pick.
  • Nonce
    copy the nonce from the current request. It is single-use and has no time limit.
  • Waiting
    a request waits until you answer it, send !viki stop or !viki new, or the bot stops.
  • Incomplete details
    the bridge requires complete operation details before offering approval; missing or oversized permission details offer Deny only.

When a request of the bot's own conversation is the only request waiting as your message arrives, you can answer in plain text instead:

  • Permission
    allow or deny.
  • Question
    option numbers (one per question, commas where a question allows several) or your own words.

While a request of the bot's own conversation waits beside another request (a relayed desktop question counts), nothing is sent to Claude. Use the command shown under the request you mean.

Questions from desktop chats

Send !viki questions on to also receive questions from your other desktop chats here, and !viki questions off to stop.

  • At every connection
    relaying desktop chat questions starts off.
  • Questions already waiting
    !viki questions on also posts any question already waiting, from every desktop chat except any messaging bridge's own conversation.
  • Permission cards
    permission cards from those chats stay on the desktop.
  • Nonces
    a desktop question's nonce works for as long as the question waits.
  • Limits
    at most 8 are held at once. A question too long to show posts a fixed notice with no nonce.
  • When this bot stops
    turning this bot off or stopping it leaves those chats' questions open on the desktop; it never denies them.

Formatting and delivery

Chat replies and status or instruction messages keep their supported formatting across providers.

  • Slack
    maps common headings and emphasis to mrkdwn.
  • Mattermost and Discord
    use their native Markdown.
  • Neutralized syntax
    URL-like text is rendered as inert code, and mention, HTML, image, and unsafe control syntax is neutralized.
  • Operation and plan details
    remain complete literal JSON.
  • Question details
    a question's detail is a readable post listing its questions and options instead.
  • Choice instructions
    sent only after the complete request has reached the DM.
  • Split posts
    provider posts may split with continuation labels.
  • Shortened replies
    shortened assistant replies direct you to the desktop.
  • Not sent
    thinking, general tool output and other desktop conversations, except a desktop chat's questions once you turn on !viki questions on.

If sending stops partway through a request, it does not grant a mobile approval. A post may have reached the service before the bot was turned off or a response was lost. Check the DM and desktop when delivery is uncertain; there is no automatic resend or choice retry.

Mattermost-only features

  • Reactions and progress
    thumbs reactions on permission requests and the progress display (👀, typing and the status reply) are Mattermost-only; see Mattermost mobile access.
  • Bot routine notices
    named Bot routine notices are Mattermost-only, with their separate launch consent. Slack and Discord do not receive them. See Bot routine notices.

05Remove configuration and roll back

Select Remove saved settings in a provider's card to delete its settings from this computer. This also turns that bot off.

  • Tokens
    Remove saved settings does not revoke the provider's tokens. They keep working until you revoke or rotate them in that provider's app settings, before or after Remove. Revoking or rotating a token does not erase messages the service or its clients already keep.
  • Rolling back
    for rolling back to an older build, see the rollback steps in Security and privacy.
  • Records
    session and approval records use the app's normal retention and reset controls.

How a post looks depends on your Slack workspace or Discord server and the app you read it in. Installing the Discord bot depends on Discord's own settings. VIKI Agent hasn't been checked against every version.
